_meta.about: Texts of the Monitor page (Settings, Utilities, Monitor): the Sysbox, Diskbox, Streambox and Seedbox dashboard tiles in one column, made for a phone. Product names (Monitor, Sysbox, Diskbox, Streambox, Seedbox, Unraid) are not translated.

btn.full_screen.note: button at the top of the page: hides the Unraid header and menu so only the tiles show. Short, it sits next to two other buttons on a phone screen.

btn.unraid_menu.note: the same button while full screen is on: shows the Unraid header and menu again. Short.

btn.reorder.note: button: starts editing the order of the tiles (up, down, hide). Short.

btn.done.note: the Reorder button while editing: ends editing. Short.

btn.reset.note: button shown while editing: puts the tiles back in the default order and shows the hidden ones. Short.

btn.hide.note: button next to a tile's name while editing: hides that tile on this page. Short.

btn.show.note: the same button for a hidden tile: shows it again. Short.

btn.up.note: tooltip of the up arrow button next to a tile's name while editing.

btn.down.note: tooltip of the down arrow button next to a tile's name while editing.

note.no_tiles.text: No tiles found. Install Sysbox, Diskbox, Streambox or Seedbox first.
note.no_tiles.note: small centred line when none of the four plugins is installed.

note.saved_here.text: The order is saved on this device only.
note.saved_here.note: small centred line under the tiles: the order and the hidden tiles are kept in this browser, not on the server.
